comparison.methodology: Matched frozen cases, prompts, schema, decoding and launch configuration compare the base artifact with the trained, materialized export. This measures the exported-model pipeline and does not isolate LoRA from materialization or effective runtime precision. Repository configuration and revisions are observed; loaded weight bytes and runtime precision are not attested.

latency.limit: Sequential 48-case descriptive timings, not a controlled significance test. Provisioning reported separately.

comparison.coverageMetric: Material-exact PROPOSED outputs on expected-PROPOSED cases; raw proposals are review volume, including unsafe guesses.
comparison.gate: Strictly improve material accuracy without relative regression; at least 80% correct supported coverage, 90% fully valid outputs, 80% correct status for each uncertainty class, and zero incorrect fully validated proposals. Owner review remains mandatory.

finalSelection.rationale: Select the frozen BF16 export of the same V5 adapter from development only: material exact 15/24 versus base 9/24, valid 24/24 versus 22/24, correct supported 8/16 versus 4/16, and incorrect validated proposals 8 versus 10. The initial quantized export regressed and remains archived. This is the only candidate for untouched final verification; no automatic financial activation.
finalSelection.boundary: Candidate chosen using development only. Final predictions cannot change this selection; owner review remains mandatory.
